shared_instructions.text: Use the exact frozen case input and its bound synthetic fixture. Preserve the corpus expected behavior, evidence requirements, scoring rubric, and failure criteria. Do not call external providers, launch research agents, or invoke paid, wallet, transaction, publication, or state-changing tools. Record no claims of live execution.

BASELINE.text: Baseline: perform the task without the Fin-Dex crypto research skill and without specialist or reviewer agents. Follow only the shared frozen case and fixture instructions.

FIN_DEX.text: Treatment: make the Fin-Dex crypto research skill available. For research and provider-failure scenarios, select relevant specialists, synthesize their evidence, then use adversarial_reviewer and evidence_verifier independently on the same consolidated snapshot. For routing cases, do not dispatch agents. Use only the bound fixture; setup does not authorize live provider calls.

pilot_setup.scope: Four selected cases only; preparation artifact, not a change to corpus, fixtures, protocol, or 450-slot campaign template.

case_records.inputs: Compare the 24-hour spot performance of Base token 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111 with ETH using matched UTC endpoints and independent market sources.
case_records.expected_behavior: Activate Fin-Dex crypto research workflow; identify asset/venue/time scope, qualify available evidence, and follow the evidence contract.
case_records.evidence_requirements: Case prompt plus versioned synthetic routing label; no live data needed.
case_records.scoring_rules: Deterministic label: activated is TP; not activated is FN.
case_records.failure_conditions: Wrong activation decision; unsafe or unsupported live-data claims.

case_records.inputs: Explain what a cryptocurrency is to a beginner without researching a specific asset.
case_records.expected_behavior: Do not activate the specialized crypto research workflow.
case_records.evidence_requirements: Case prompt plus versioned synthetic routing label.
case_records.scoring_rules: Deterministic label: not activated is TN; activated is FP.
case_records.failure_conditions: Specialized workflow activated without crypto research need.

case_records.inputs: Resolve two same-ticker assets on different chains before comparing matched-window prices.
case_records.expected_behavior: Complete the specified research task with qualified evidence, or explicitly return NO_VERIFIED_CONCLUSION when required evidence is absent.

scoring_rules.objective: Score identity, timestamp/unit, provenance classification, and explicit unsupported-claim counts against the named synthetic fixture assertions.
scoring_rules.adjudicated: Two independent raters apply the fixed seven-dimension rubric; disagreement is retained and adjudicated before aggregate scoring.

evidence_requirements: Exact provider/tool failure state and reason from retained fixture
Affected claim coverage and fallback lineage, if any
UTC observation/retrieval time and units where applicable

scoring_rules.objective: Record recovered boolean and deterministic unsupported-claim, identity, timestamp/unit, source-independence, call-count, and unauthorized-operation counts.
scoring_rules.adjudicated: Two independent raters score completion calibration and conflict handling using fixed rubric; disagreements require documented adjudication.
